defects.title: Null pointer dereference of rootItem in AbstractTreeModel::checkConsistency()
defects.root_cause: When !rootItem was true, the single compound if-condition entered the debug branch and immediately dereferenced rootItem->m_isRoot and rootItem->isInModel().
defects.reproduction: Static cppcheck nullPointerRedundantCheck + calling AbstractTreeModel::checkConsistency() when rootItem is null.
defects.remediation: Split null check into an early guard returning false before logging member fields.
defects.regression_test: Linux & macOS full build + CTest suites (5/5 pass); cppcheck nullPointer check clean on file.

defects.title: Uninitialized TimeWarpInfo fields and unsafe strcmp on nullable mlt_service pointer
defects.root_cause: ProjectClip::TimeWarpInfo was default-constructed with uninitialized members, and strcmp(link->get("mlt_service"), "timeremap") could dereference nullptr if the MLT link lacked an mlt_service property.
defects.reproduction: Manual inspection & cppcheck uninitStructMember / null pointer audit in ProjectClip::giveMasterAndGetTimelineProducer().
defects.remediation: Aggregate-initialized TimeWarpInfo{false, QString(), 0, QString()} and switched strcmp to null-safe qstrcmp.
defects.regression_test: Linux & macOS full build + CTest suites (5/5 pass).

defects.title: ProxyTask ignored non-zero process exit codes, image save failures, division-by-zero and raw temp-file leak risk
defects.root_cause: ProxyTask checked only exitStatus() == NormalExit (treating non-zero FFmpeg/melt failures as success), ignored QImage::save() return values, could divide by oW==0 or dar==0, and held a raw QTemporaryFile*.
defects.reproduction: Manual audit + failing proxy FFmpeg/melt command returning exit code 1 or unwritable image destination.
defects.remediation: Replaced raw pointer with std::unique_ptr<QTemporaryFile>, verified playlist->open(), required error() != FailedToStart && NormalExit && exitCode() == 0, verified QImage::save() + non-empty file on disk, and guarded oW>0 and dar>1e-6.
defects.regression_test: Linux & macOS build + clang-tidy clean + test_project_integrity.py.

defects.title: MonitorProxy::extractFrame configured profile from unvalidated MLT producer
defects.root_cause: tmpProfile->from_producer(*tmpProd) ran before checking if (tmpProd && tmpProd->is_valid()).
defects.reproduction: Extracting a frame when the underlying media resource cannot be opened by MLT.
defects.remediation: Moved tmpProfile->from_producer(*tmpProd), width, and height assignment inside the tmpProd && tmpProd->is_valid() guard.
defects.regression_test: Linux & macOS build + live Xvfb GUI verification.

defects.title: Unchecked null binClip dereferences in ClipModel constructor, construct(), registerClipToBin(), and deregisterClipToBin()
defects.root_cause: ClipModel called binClip->hasVideo()/hasAudio()/clipType() BEFORE checking if (binClip), and construct()/registerClipToBin()/deregisterClipToBin() dereferenced missing bin clips when timeline references outlived bin items.
defects.reproduction: Opening a sequence or undoing an operation referencing a deleted/missing bin clip ID.
defects.remediation: Guarded all four paths against null binClip with safe defaults (-1 / early return + qWarning).
defects.regression_test: Linux & macOS build + TimelineCommandEngine deleted-entity regression tests.

defects.title: Uncaught std::out_of_range crash in TimelineModel::getTrackPosition()
defects.root_cause: m_iteratorTable.at(trackId) threw std::out_of_range in release builds (where Q_ASSERT is compiled out) when queried with an invalid/deleted trackId.
defects.reproduction: Querying getTrackPosition() on a stale track ID in release builds.
defects.remediation: Replaced .at(trackId) with m_iteratorTable.find(trackId) and safe -1 fallback with warning.

defects.title: Null dereference and broken bitmask operator precedence in GraphicsSceneRectMove::mouseDoubleClickEvent()
defects.root_cause: while loop dereferenced g before checking g != nullptr, and the subsequent check wrote (g->flags() & static_cast<int>((QGraphicsItem::ItemIsSelectable) != 0)) which masked against 1 instead of ItemIsSelectable (2).
defects.reproduction: Double-clicking in Title Editor scene on non-selectable/null graphics items; flagged by cppcheck/manual review.
defects.remediation: Added g != nullptr guard and replaced broken bitmask expression with g->flags().testFlag(QGraphicsItem::ItemIsSelectable).

defects.title: RenderWidget job teardown, exit-code validation, thread safety and Qt5/Qt6 const-iteration fixes
defects.root_cause: Render job lifecycle lacked defensive checks on aborted/failed processes, script preparation, destructor cleanup, and used C++17 std::as_const incompatible with Linux Qt5 C++14 builds.
defects.reproduction: Aborting or failing render jobs and compiling across Qt5 (Linux C++14) + Qt6 (macOS C++17).
defects.remediation: Hardened job status transitions, process exit validation, safe destructor teardown, and standardized qAsConst across Qt5/Qt6.
defects.regression_test: Linux Qt5 & macOS Qt6 compilation + real MLT melt render pipeline tests.

defects.title: Project persistence safety: atomic saveSceneList, sequence/timeline null guards, subtitle & backup hardening
defects.root_cause: Non-atomic writes and missing null/existence guards on timeline maps, sequence properties, and subtitle paths risked corrupted .kdenlive files or crashes during save/close.
defects.reproduction: Manual audit of KdenliveDoc::saveSceneList(), closeTimeline(), checkConsistency(), and sequence property helpers + test_project_integrity.py.
defects.remediation: Hardened scene-list saving, timeline map lookups, subtitle path resolution, and backup creation.

defects.title: ProjectManager null-document & sequence-switch lifecycle guards
defects.root_cause: ProjectManager::openFile, doOpenFile, doOpenFileHeadless, openTimeline, updateTimeline, and doSyncTimeline had paths that could dereference null m_project or inactive timeline models during aborted loads or project switches.
defects.reproduction: Manual audit + rapid project open/abort/switch scenarios.
defects.remediation: Added defensive null checks and clean rollback handling across document open, close, and timeline sync paths.
defects.regression_test: Linux & macOS builds + headless GUI startup & project integrity tests.

defects.title: Stale-proposal protection bypassed by overwriting expectedRevision on approval
defects.root_cause: In V1.0, AI batch approval replaced expectedRevision with the current live revision right before commit, silently overwriting manual edits, deleted clips/tracks, or even edits after switching project/sequence.
defects.reproduction: Generate AI proposal at rev N, manually edit or switch project/sequence or delete target clip/track, then approve proposal.
defects.remediation: Capture proposal base revision, project_id, sequence_id, and live state fingerprint BEFORE async AI execution; validateProposalFreshnessLocked rejects StaleRevision, ManualEditDrift, ContextMismatch, and EntityConflict; added explicit UI conflict banner with safe Rebase & Apply (strictly blocked on ContextMismatch/EntityConflict) or Regenerate Proposal.

defects.title: Partial/selective batch approval allowed broken intra-batch dependencies
defects.root_cause: Users could uncheck a prerequisite operation (e.g., create_track or insert_clip) while keeping a dependent operation checked, causing partial failure or cryptic EntityConflict.
defects.reproduction: Uncheck op 0 (create_track/insert_clip) while selecting op 1 referencing that new entity in approveBatchWithSelection().
defects.remediation: Added analyzeSelectionDependencies() and invoked it BEFORE freshness checking in approveBatchWithSelection() so missing intra-batch prerequisites cleanly return ValidationError with exact missing dependency details.

defects.title: Compare (A/B) preview mutated the live undo stack instead of using an isolated preview
defects.root_cause: V1.0 toggleCompareMode() called undo/redo on the live timeline to show before/after.
defects.reproduction: Click Compare (A/B) on a pending AI proposal and inspect live timeline revision/state.
defects.remediation: Implemented simulateBatchOnIsolatedCloneLocked() and previewPendingProposal() operating strictly on an isolated in-memory clone (returning live_timeline_mutated: false and zero live timeline changes) rendered in AiAssistantDock's preview summary.

defects.title: Open-project AI edits forced media re-import and mismatched C++/Python timeline_state.json schema
defects.root_cause: C++ did not pass read-only timeline state JSON to the AI CLI, --sequence-id defaulted to 'seq_main' overriding the active sequence, and planner.py did not unwrap nested 'state' / 'frame_range' / 'kind' / 'media_bin' emitted by TimelineCommandEngine::stateSnapshotJson().
defects.reproduction: Run AI instruction against an open unsaved/saved Kdenlive project without passing --inputs.
defects.remediation: C++ KdenliveTimelineBridge::captureReadOnlyStateJson() exports live timeline state to --project-state (+ --kdenlive-project when saved); cli.py defaults --sequence-id to None; planner.py unwraps C++ snapshot schema and plans in-place edits without media re-import.

defects.title: Narrow intent handling collapsed targeted edit prompts into full rough cuts and lacked clarification flow
defects.root_cause: V1.0 intent parser mapped many natural-language prompts directly into full rough-cut assembly and had no structured needs_clarification flow for ambiguous instructions.
defects.reproduction: Submit targeted edit instructions (e.g. 'trim silence', 'add captions', 'fix audio') or vague instructions ('make it better').
defects.remediation: Rebuilt intent classifier and deterministic/LLM planner supporting 14+ scoped edit actions, surgical edits on active sequences, and structured needs_clarification responses surfaced in AiAssistantDock's Clarification banner.

defects.title: No local AI model lifecycle manager or honest neural-vs-fallback reporting in desktop UI
defects.root_cause: Users had no native UI or CLI to inspect hardware tier, download/verify/import/remove Whisper/SAM/RNNoise weights, or distinguish genuine neural execution from DSP/OpenCV fallbacks.
defects.reproduction: Run ASR or Roto without installed weights; status was ambiguous.
defects.remediation: Built bangonpro.ai_engine.model_manager (SHA-256 verified install, local import, removal, hardware tier detection) and native dark-studio ModelManagerDialog wired into Bang On Pro menu and AiAssistantDock, plus dedicated persistent RotoStudioDock backend badge.

defects.title: Real Faster-Whisper neural inference crashed on PyAV metadata_errors and CLI summary omitted asr_backend_used
defects.root_cause: Discovered during genuine Faster-Whisper Tiny neural execution: newer PyAV raised TypeError on faster_whisper's internal av.open(..., metadata_errors='ignore'), WhisperModel ignored model_manager download_root, and cli.py read top-level metadata keys instead of state.metadata['asr_backend_report'].
defects.reproduction: Install faster-whisper 1.2.1 and run bangonpro.ai_engine.cli with --asr-model faster-whisper-tiny on real spoken audio.
defects.remediation: Decoded 16kHz float32 mono PCM via extract_mono_pcm() and passed numpy ndarray + download_root directly to WhisperModel.transcribe(); fixed cli.py summary extraction from asr_backend_report.
defects.regression_test: Live neural verification on espeak-ng spoken English MP4 -> backend_id='faster_whisper', is_neural_inference=True, fallback_used=False, 2 recognized English segments & captions.

defects.title: MobileSAM ONNX neural weight discovery and rank-3 HWC tensor input mismatch
defects.root_cause: Discovered during genuine MobileSAM ONNX execution: _find_sam_onnx_pair missed ModelManager's 'mobilesam-onnx' subdir and Acly filenames ('mobile_sam_image_encoder.onnx', 'sam_mask_decoder_single.onnx'), and assumed rank-4 NCHW encoder input whereas Acly MobileSAM encoder requires rank-3 float32 RGB HWC (longest-side 1024).
defects.reproduction: Install MobileSAM ONNX weights via ModelManager and execute segment_frame_detailed() with onnxruntime 1.32.0.
defects.remediation: Added ModelManager subdirectory & Acly ONNX filename discovery plus automatic encoder input rank inspection (supporting both rank-3 HWC longest-side-1024 and rank-4 NCHW 1024x1024).
defects.regression_test: Live MobileSAM ONNX execution on 640x360 test frame -> backend_id='mobile_sam_onnx', is_neural_inference=True, confidence=1.0, fg_alpha_mean=0.999993, bg_alpha_mean=0.000001.

defects.title: Subprocess environment leaked host secrets and QProcess exit codes were not uniformly verified
defects.root_cause: Python subprocesses inherited the full parent environment (including unrelated API tokens/secrets), and some finished callbacks did not verify QProcess::NormalExit && exitCode == 0.
defects.reproduction: Audit of startPython() and QProcess::finished handlers in BangOnProIntegration.cpp.
defects.remediation: Enforced strict environment allowlist in startPython() (forwarding only safe runtime/locale/Qt/BangOnPro variables) and verified status == QProcess::NormalExit && code == 0 in every finished handler.

defects.title: Workspace/AI shortcut action names mismatched KActionCollection and lacked conflict detection
defects.root_cause: Shortcut presets referenced bangonpro_workspace_<id>, bangonpro_toggle_ai, and bangonpro_shortcut_presets, which were not consistently registered under those exact object/action names, and no automated conflict detector verified preset integrity.
defects.reproduction: Apply Premiere/Resolve/Kdenlive shortcut presets and verify action bindings & collisions.
defects.remediation: Aligned actionCollection() registrations with preset IDs and implemented ShortcutPresetManager::detectShortcutConflicts() confirming 0 unintended collisions across premiere, resolve, and kdenlive presets.

defects.title: RotoStudioDock transient keyframe messages overwrote segmentation backend status
defects.root_cause: Single status label shared both neural/fallback backend identity and transient operation messages.
defects.reproduction: Add a keyframe or run tracking in RotoStudioDock and observe backend label overwritten.
defects.remediation: Added dedicated persistent m_backendStatusLabel and setSegmentationBackendStatus(backendName, isNeural, details).

defects.title: Identifier validation allowed ASCII control characters and unvalidated payload edge cases
defects.root_cause: isValidIdentifier() permitted control bytes (< 0x20 / 0x7F) that could corrupt XML/JSON/log serialization.
defects.reproduction: Send timeline IPC commands containing control chars (\x00-\x1f, \x7f) or malformed JSON/oversized payloads.
defects.remediation: Hardened isValidIdentifier() to reject all control characters and added targeted malformed-payload & control-char fuzz test suite under ASan+UBSan.

defects.title: 50+ mypy type-safety defects across Python AI engine & Premiere compatibility modules
defects.root_cause: Unchecked Optional[Parameter] dereferences in catalog.py, GzipFile buffer overload mismatch in parser.py, shadowed variable types in transcribe_diarise.py and rough_cut_multicam.py, and outdated AiProviderConfig attributes in cli.py.
defects.reproduction: Run mypy --ignore-missing-imports bangonpro/ on V1.0 commit 1f7e2df8e3.
defects.remediation: Fixed all type narrowing, Optional guards, GzipFile wrapper, and provider config attributes across all 42 Python source files.
defects.regression_test: mypy --ignore-missing-imports bangonpro/ -> 'Success: no issues found in 42 source files'.

defects.title: Benchmarks lacked sustained workloads, virtualized-vs-bare-metal attribution, and hardened packaging verification
defects.root_cause: V1.0 benchmarks used short synthetic clips without explicit host-tier attribution (virtualized CI vs bare-metal Apple Silicon vs Linux CPU fallback) or sustained RSS/cache-growth tracking.
defects.reproduction: Inspect V1.0 benchmark_report.md and packaging verification log.
defects.remediation: Upgraded benchmark.py to 8 sustained workloads (1080p/4K decode/export, 4K->720p proxy, 4-cam sync+melt render, AI VAD, Roto optical flow) with explicit host_tier, virtualized flag, peak RSS, cache growth, and dropped-frame metrics; hardened build_macos_arm64.sh relocation, rpath verification, ad-hoc vs Developer ID signing status, and bundled runtime checks.
defects.regression_test: tests/bangonpro/test_macos_perf.py (14/14 PASS) + sustained Linux & macOS CI benchmark runs.

defects.title: CI Linux passed --require-ruff to run_all_checks.py before the CLI flag was registered
defects.root_cause: ci-linux.yml invoked run_all_checks.py --require-ruff, causing argparse exit code 2 in Linux CI run 45480025382.
defects.reproduction: python3 tests/bangonpro/run_all_checks.py --require-ruff
defects.remediation: Wired --require-ruff into ArgumentParser and run_static_checks(require_ruff=args.require_ruff) so ruff is strictly enforced in CI.

defects.title: User-proprietary Premiere archive ('effects pr.zip' / 'Bang_on_pro_premiere_preset_audit.json') not present in repository
defects.root_cause: The external 578-preset Premiere Pro archive referenced in production requirements was never committed to the repository or uploaded to the workspace.
defects.reproduction: Search repository and workspace for 'effects pr.zip' or 'Bang_on_pro_premiere_preset_audit.json' -> absent.
defects.remediation: Cannot fabricate an audit of proprietary assets that are absent. Shipped a verified 64-preset GPL-3.0 Bang On Pro Native Starter Library (45 Exact Validated, 19 Approximated, 0 Missing Dep, 0 Unsupported) with visual_equivalence_evidence and full .prfpset/.zip/.rar import pipeline ready to ingest user archives locally via Import Archive….

defects.title: Apple Developer ID signing/notarization & physical bare-metal Apple Silicon validation require external credentials/hardware
defects.root_cause: GitHub repository secrets (APPLE_CERTIFICATE_BASE64, APPLE_NOTARY_KEY, etc.) are not configured, and CI executes on virtualized macos-15 Apple Silicon runners rather than physical bare-metal M1/M2/M3/M4 machines.
defects.reproduction: Inspect SIGNING_STATUS.txt and benchmark_report.md from macOS CI artifacts.
defects.remediation: Build scripts fully support Developer ID + notarytool when secrets are supplied, clearly emit SIGNING_STATUS.txt (ad-hoc signed when secrets absent), and explicitly tag macOS CI benchmarks as virtualized apple_silicon_ci_vm rather than bare-metal.

outstanding_and_excluded.description: User-proprietary Premiere Pro archive ('effects pr.zip') and prior audit ('Bang_on_pro_premiere_preset_audit.json') are absent from the repository; 578-preset audit cannot be performed without those inputs. Shipped verified 64-preset GPL-3.0 starter library + live importer instead.

Apple Developer ID signing/notarization secrets are not configured in CI (release DMG is ad-hoc signed with SIGNING_STATUS.txt), and CI benchmarks execute on virtualized GitHub macOS 15 arm64 runners rather than bare-metal M1/M2/M3/M4 hardware.

317 informational/style/performance cppcheck findings in untouched upstream Kdenlive files (e.g. passedByValue, postfixOperator, virtualCallInConstructor) are intentionally deferred to preserve upstream Kdenlive 24.08 stability.
